value.title: Value
value.description: What to write into `field`: number, boolean (ev.has) or 0 for 'none' (existingPv.kwp, existingStorage.kwh).

components.title: Components
components.description: Components whose presence or catalog size changes with the answer.

priceSwingEur.title: Priceswingeur
priceSwingEur.description: Largest difference in installed price between the possible answers (EUR, market.json mid prices).

field.title: Field
field.description: Dotted camelCase path into HomeInputs: demandKwh, building.roofMaxModules, ev.has, heating.heatDemandKwh, existingPv.kwp, existingStorage.kwh.

AskNext.title: AskNext
AskNext.description: One missing input worth asking for (value of information): re-running the policy over plausible answers changes the design.

BatteryPoint.title: BatteryPoint
BatteryPoint.description: One point of the "why this size" curve (new battery size, PV fixed).

current.description: Existing design whose locked components are kept.

askNext.title: Asknext
askNext.description: At most 3 missing inputs ranked by P(design changes) x price swing; empty when nothing is worth asking.

ems.title: Ems
ems.description: Expert-match score 0-100 (primary option); every other score is a 0-1 fraction.

wholeDesign.title: Wholedesign
wholeDesign.description: Share of homes where every component is within tolerance (0-1).

tolerances.title: Tolerances
tolerances.description: Relative size error that still counts as matching the expert, per component.

name.title: Name
name.description: Dotted camelCase path into HomeInputs, e.g. 'ev.has'.

synthetic.title: Synthetic
synthetic.description: True when the engine runs on synthetic/fallback data, not the real dataset.

hourlyTypicalDays.title: Hourlytypicaldays
hourlyTypicalDays.description: {summer|winter: {pvKwh, loadKwh, batteryKwh, gridKwh, socKwh: 24 hourly means}}; proposal and /simulate only.

economicKwh.title: Economickwh
economicKwh.description: Economic battery optimum (max NPV, capped by night load and the 150-350 cycles/yr band); 0 = none pays.

maxAutarkyKwh.title: Maxautarkykwh
maxAutarkyKwh.description: Smallest battery reaching 99% of the best autarky (uneconomic variant).

PvPoint.title: PvPoint
PvPoint.description: One point of the PV size curve (battery fixed).

text.title: Text
text.description: Template sentence for the planner; the LLM may rephrase but never change numbers.

system.description: System to simulate; missing components count as 'none'.
The planner's system; missing components count as 'none'.

percentiles.title: Percentiles
percentiles.description: 0-100 percentile of the planner's size among similar homes that got the component.

similarShare.title: Similarshare
similarShare.description: Share of similar homes that got the component.

metrics.description: Simulated metrics of the planner's system.
